name: Securities Financing Reporting Missing Collateral Request V 02
definition: The SecuritiesFinancingReportingMissingCollateralRequest is made available by the trade repository (TR) to the  report submitting entity and the reporting counterparty as well as the entity responsible for reporting, if applicable, with a request to submit collateral information for a given trade.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Set of information identifying the missing transactions that are to be supplemented.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
